CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING DIVISION
  P L A NN I NG C OM M I S S I O N M E ET I N G A G EN D A
October 2, 2024, 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to address
  the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda other than a
  public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Minute(s) approval for September 4, 2024, Planning Commission
  meeting.

6.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A public hearing to consider an application by Spencer Regnery,
  representing Equilon Enterprises LLC, for Special Use Permit No.
  24-00021 (SUP24-00021) to allow an electric vehicle charging
  service station on an approximately 13,939 square-foot MU-C (TOD
  Mixed Use Corridor) zoned property at 701 West Manchester
  Boulevard.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the categorical exemption EA-CE-2024-111;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving SUP24-00021.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or
  any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6a Documents

  b. A public hearing to consider Zoning Code Amendment No. 24-00001
  (ZCA24-00001) to establish objective design standards for
  Chapter 12 of the Inglewood Municipal Code. (Staff is requesting
  this item be continued to November 6, 2024)

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the categorical exemption EA-CE-2024-114;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving ZCA No. 24-00001.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or
  any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6b Documents
 6.  PUBLIC HEARINGS (cont’d.)
  c. A Public Hearing to consider Zoning Code Amendment No. 24-00002
  (ZCA24-00002) to Establish Inclusionary Zoning Regulations to
  Chapter 12 of the Inglewood Municipal Code. (Staff is requesting
  this item be continued to November 6, 2024)

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A.If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the categorical exemption EA-CE-2024-115;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving ZCA No. 24-00002.
  B.If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C.If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or
  any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6c Documents

7.  NON-PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A non-public hearing to consider an application by Ann MacDonald
  to allow two (2) murals on an existing 3,000 square-foot fast-
  food restaurant that is part of an existing shopping center on
  an approximately 3.2-acre M-1L (Limited Manufacturing) zoned
  property at 3510 West Century Boulevard.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2024-117;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving DR24-00035.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the requestor
  any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 7a Documents

  b. A non-public hearing to consider an application by Derrick Pete
  to allow an approximately 4,000 square-foot mural on an
  approximately 88,655 square-foot office building on an
  approximately three acre MU-2 (TOD Mixed Use 2) zoned property
  at 333 West Florence Avenue.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2024-113;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving DR24-00037.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the requestor
  any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 7b Documents

 8.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning Commission
  on any matter within their jurisdiction and not elsewhere
  considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

9.  Commission Initiatives.

10.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations due to a disability, please
contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One Manchester
Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All
requests for special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to
the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of October 2, 2024,
is not held or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other agenda
item being considered, the public hearing or non-public hearing agenda
item will automatically be continued to the next regular Planning
Commission meeting.

  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
